title: Characterization of a Ku-binding motif in the C-terminal region of RAG2.
authors: Tadi, Satish K; Gesnik, Armelle; Nabhan, Lea; Frit, Philippe; Iehl, Florence; Ropars, Virginie; Dingli, Florent; Loew, Damarys; Calsou, Patrick; Callebaut, Isabelle; Cuniasse, Philippe; Charbonnier, Jean-Baptiste; de Villartay, Jean-Pierre
one_liner_zh: 该文通过质谱、热力学实验及AlphaFold2与分子动力学模拟，表征RAG2 C端Ku结合基序与Ku70/80-DNA复合物的互作机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作且方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: We applied an unsupervised interactome analysis with the RAG2 C-terminal region (R2CT) in v-abl pro-B cells undergoing V(D)J recombination. Mass-spectrometry analyses showed that Ku70 and Ku80 were among the top 10 hits. To further strengthen these observations, we performed Proximity Ligation Assay (PLA) and characterize the existence of a GFP-R2CT-Ku complex formation in cellulo. The interaction of several partners with Ku70/80 (Ku) through Ku-binding motifs (KBMs) in their sequences governs their enrolment in NHEJ repair complexes. Through sequence analysis, we identified a KBM within R2CT (R-KBM, amino acids 589-527). We confirmed by calorimetry a specific micromolar interaction between this RAG2 region and Ku70/80/DNA complex. The RAG2 motif KBM can be subdivided in two conserved parts that have no interaction individually. AlphaFold2 prediction coupled with molecular dynamic simulations indicate that the C-terminal part of the RAG2 motif interacts with Ku80 on the same site than the NHEJ factor XLF. These in silico analyses indicated that the N-terminal part of the RAG2 motif interacts with DNA adjacent to Ku with a major role of the K503 residue in agreement with disruption of the interaction observed with the K503E mutant. This study further extends the large ensemble of proteins recruited at DSBs by KBM motifs and substantiates the model of a tight coupling between DNA breakage and repair during V(D)J recombination, mediated by the Ku-RAG2 C-terminus interaction.
abstract_zh: 我们在进行V(D)J重组的v-abl前B细胞中，应用了针对RAG2 C末端区域（R2CT）的无监督相互作用组分析。质谱分析显示，Ku70和Ku80位列前10个命中项。为进一步强化这些观察结果，我们进行了邻近连接实验（PLA），并在细胞内表征了GFP-R2CT-Ku复合物的存在。多个伙伴通过其序列中的Ku结合基序（KBMs）与Ku70/80（Ku）的相互作用，决定了它们在NHEJ修复复合物中的招募。通过序列分析，我们在R2CT内识别出一个KBM（R-KBM，氨基酸589-527）。我们通过量热法确认了该RAG2区域与Ku70/80/DNA复合物之间存在特异性微摩尔级相互作用。RAG2基序KBM可细分为两个保守部分，它们单独无相互作用。AlphaFold2预测结合分子动力学模拟表明，RAG2基序的C末端部分与Ku80相互作用，位点与NHEJ因子XLF相同。这些计算机模拟分析指出，RAG2基序的N末端部分与Ku相邻的DNA相互作用，其中K503残基起主要作用，这与K503E突变体观察到的相互作用破坏一致。本研究进一步扩展了通过KBM基序在DSB处招募的大量蛋白质集合，并支持了在V(D)J重组过程中，由Ku-RAG2 C末端相互作用介导的DNA断裂与修复紧密偶联的模型。
